title: Tooltips Configuration
description: Schema for the data-driven help tooltips displayed by TooltipOverlaySystem

enabled.description: Global switch. false disables all tooltips regardless of their frequency

panel.description: Style of the screen-space tooltip panel

id.description: Unique id, stored in persist.json TooltipsSeen

item.description: Item key the event must carry, see items.json

text.description: Message to display. "{item}" is replaced by the display name of the item carried by the triggering event

position.description: Where the panel is drawn. Defaults to {"x": 0.5, "y": 0.85}

oneOf.description: Panel centre as a fraction of the display resolution
Centred above the world object that raised the event (e.g. the altar), following the camera. Falls back to the default if the event carries no object
Centred above the player, following the camera. Falls back to the default if the scene has no player

duration_s.description: Seconds the tooltip is displayed for. Optional: defaults to 5, except for a pausing tooltip, which without it stays until dismissed with Enter and has "Press <Enter> to dismiss." appended to its text

pause.description: Optional, default false. If true, gameplay is paused while the tooltip is shown; it resumes when the tooltip expires or is dismissed with Enter. Omit "duration_s" to pause until Enter is pressed
